title: Setengah Cokelat Setengah Kacang
subject: a young couple in Bandung at midnight with money for only one martabak manis, arguing chocolate-cheese against peanut at the cart on Dago until they order it half and half and end up feeding each other the other side
caption: Indonesian spoken-word art pop in the vein of mid-2020s Jakarta storyteller pop. Felt upright piano playing soft repeated chords, a muted electric guitar arpeggio, a warm low synth pad, brushed drum kit with a gentle rimshot, round fretless bass. Intimate bedroom-studio mix with a little tape hiss. Male baritone, half-spoken conversational verses opening into a plainly sung chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Tender, teasing, warm. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM build, no gospel choir, no stadium drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - felt piano and brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua belas di Dago
Gerobak martabak masih buka
Uang kita cuma cukup satu
Kamu bilang, cokelat keju

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku bilang, kacang dong
Abangnya nunggu, ketawa

[Chorus]
Setengah cokelat, setengah kacang
Satu kotak buat berdua
Kamu ambil potongan tengah
Aku diam, aku suka

[Verse 2]
Duduk di jok motor yang dingin
Mentega netes di jarimu
Kamu cicip punyaku, lumayan katamu
Lalu ambil satu lagi

[Bridge - piano alone, spoken]
Besok pasti kita ribut lagi
Di gerobak yang sama

[Chorus]
Setengah cokelat, setengah kacang
Tinggal satu potong di kotak
Kamu sodorkan ke mulutku
Yang kacang, buat kamu

[Outro - piano and pad fade]
